note: Audit pass 3: framework + axHub side. SettingsRegistry keys declared or written in framework/react, framework/libs, framework/core and the web apps (browser stores), the hub settings documents under /projects/_shared/_data/settings (appearance@1, app-look@1, skins, apps), other shared documents, the axHub web app's settings code and the Kotlin twins (listed, not scanned).
caveats: browser:axf.settings.<app> rows are SettingsRegistry keys (localStorage per app). axf.appearance.spacing, axf.skin.look, axf.lock.* are the runtime's applied/working copies of hub documents (APPEARANCE-SOURCE.md): the hub document is the owner.

settings/appearance.json still carries slots / spacing / hidden / palette beside skin / defaultSkin / settings (token overrides); each app's looks/<app>.json owns slots, spacing and hidden (app-look@1). Android (lib-hub HubAppearanceSource, AppearanceEngine) reads only appearance.json: a Kotlin twin of app-look@1 is a deferred gap, so the shared slots stay until it exists.

settings/apps/<app>.json (hub-settings@1, framework/libs/hubstore) is a per-app hub copy of SettingsRegistry values (fontScale, alerts-bell.*, axf.appearance.spacing, axf.dev.defaultModel …), last written Oct 31 2026: a stale snapshot of what the browser registry owns.

Chrome settings (axf.chrome.<kind>.<instance>, axf.chrome.settings.<kind>) and tap-to-confirm (SettingSpec.confirm) are registry keys applied from the composed skin (skin.chrome) and own.settings of the look document: no second store found.
The axhub-adapter-axf plugin lives in the axHub repo (MossesX/axHub), not here; its hub settings documents are the ones under /projects/_shared/_data/settings listed above.
Kotlin files are listed, not scanned (no new Android work: PORTING.md records the twin as a deferred gap).
